sophia: Heads-up — ran into a weird interop problem when switching a sample app from Webpack -> esbuild -> Bun. Docs show `default` and named export examples but not the pitfalls.
sophia: Minimal repro: a CJS microservice using `require('@redwood/inference')` works locally on Node 16, but after we switched to esbuild bundling for deployment we see `TypeError: (0 , _inference.default) is not a constructor`.
sophia: My package.json has "type": "commonjs" and we ship `main` pointing to dist/index.cjs, `module` to dist/index.esm.mjs, and `exports` with both.
raj: This smells like dual-package interop + bundler rewriting import/default shapes. esbuild/rollup will convert `export default` -> `exports.default` for CJS and sometimes add a `.default` interop helper. Bun has its own loader semantics too.
ben: If you want a short list for docs: 1) show `require('@redwood/inference').RedwoodClient` vs `.default` vs destructure; 2) show `import { RedwoodClient } from` and `import RedwoodClient from` and when they differ; 3) add common Bun/Next.js/Cloudflare notes.
sophia: Example that fixed our build: in CJS handler use `const { createRequire } = require('module'); const requireFromCwd = createRequire(process.cwd() + '/'); const { RedwoodClient } = requireFromCwd('@redwood/inference');` — gross but works across bundlers. We shouldn't recommend that as first line though.
devops: Also note: next.js serverless Edge functions force ESM and Vercel may load the `exports` -> `./edge.mjs` path if present. If you add a top-level `./edge` export entry in package.json we can provide a smaller shim for Workers.
raj: For TypeScript teams: add guidance to set `esModuleInterop: true` or show `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` pattern. Also include `--target node16` or above note.
docs-bot: TODO created: add SDK interop appendix + bundler matrix (PR requested @sophia) — ticket SDK-interop-1209.
ben: Small nit: include a short Rollup config snippet that preserves `exports: 'named'` so users don't accidentally get a default-only build.
sophia: Might be helpful to add a tiny troubleshooting checklist in quickstart: 1) what exact file is being loaded (node -p "require.resolve('@redwood/inference')") 2) check package.json exports 3) try named import/require first 4) tsconfig flags to toggle.
raj: We should also mention common error messages and what they imply: "is not a constructor" => probably default vs named mismatch; "Cannot use import statement outside a module" => CJS/ESM runtime mismatch; "SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'" => bundler loading an ESM file in CJS runtime.
devops: I'll add a brief Cloudflare Worker example and a Vercel Edge snippet. @ben can you add the Rollup note?
ben: Yep. I'll draft a tiny code gallery showing all 6 patterns (CJS require named, CJS require default, ESM named, ESM default, TS with esModuleInterop on, Bun/Edge note).
sophia: Thanks — this has been tripping up a lot of small teams onboarding. If we can land a compact interop section on the quickstart it would reduce support noise. :pray:
docs-bot: PR opened: docs/sdk-interop-matrix (https://git.redwood/docs/pull/439) reviewers: @ben, @raj, @sophia
